name: Joe Mathis
why: The labelled candidate mugshot run with the 1998 treasurer race, and the only photograph of him found. Small newspaper halftone at the scan native resolution, contrasty, but full-face and in focus. Filed against the archive spelling Mathis; the Herald spells him Matheis throughout. The two are one person: the paper calls him a two-year congress member in April 1998, and he signed a letter in April 1997 as Henderson freshman, so he sat in Congress in 1996-97, which is the year the archive records for Joe Mathis on the roll call of 29 October 1996. No second Joe Math- appears anywhere in the 1996-99 Herald.
caption_quote: Name: Joe Matheis Hometown: Henderson Class: Sophomore Major: Business
id_note: Two label blocks run side by side under the story, each with its portrait immediately to its right: Carleton Ruminer left, Joe Matheis right. This crop is the right-hand portrait. The story beside it reads: the other candidate, Henderson sophomore Joe Matheis, has a little experience.
